changelog:
StudySeat Buddy 1.0.0 — initial release!

- Enables university students to quickly find available classrooms for various study needs (self-study, group work, meetings, exam prep).
- Recognizes learning scenarios (e.g., rushing deadlines, exam prep, group discussion) and adjusts recommendations accordingly.
- Filters classrooms based on real-time schedule, capacity, user preferences (e.g., outlets, quietness), and recent on-site feedback.
- Avoids recommending rooms with scheduling conflicts or known issues and clearly explains recommendation logic.
- Provides actionable suggestions and highlights potential pitfalls or usage requirements for each recommendation.
